name: creatoros-youtube
description: Ask Claude how your YouTube channel is really doing: private analytics, per-video bottlenecks, fair comparisons, best publishing times and audience questions. Read-only; runs locally on your computer.

google_client_id.title: Google OAuth Client ID
google_client_id.description: Optional. From Google Cloud Console > Google Auth Platform > Clients > your 'Desktop app' client. If left empty (e.g. in Cowork, which doesn't ask for plugin settings), CreatorOS uses client_secret.json in the .creatoros folder of your user directory. See README > Configuration.

google_client_secret.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
google_client_secret.description: Optional. Client secret of the same Desktop app client (stored in secure storage). If empty, client_secret.json in .creatoros is used.

youtube_api_key.title: YouTube Data API key (optional)
youtube_api_key.description: Optional. Only needed to read comments; restrict it to 'YouTube Data API v3'. If empty, api_key.txt in .creatoros is used when present.
